title: Qui-Gon Jinn
subtitle: Jedi
description: Qui-Gon Jinn was a Jedi Master in the time leading up to the Clone Wars. Jinn's independent thinking and unwilingness to always go with the flow set him apart from most of his fellow Jedi. Qui-Gon's way of thinking often gave him insight, particularly in combat and problem-solving situations, but it always prevented his placement on the Jedi Council.
